title: FBS Logistics Shipment Metadata Schema v1.0.0
description: Domain-specific metadata schema for logistics shipments. Incorporates the FBS Core Metadata Schema via allOf to ensure all core interoperability fields are present.

carrier.description: Name of the carrier responsible for transporting the shipment.

trackingNumber.description: External tracking number assigned by the carrier, if applicable.

weight.description: Total weight of the shipment with units. Example: '2.3kg'.

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the shipment package with units. Example: '30x20x15cm'.

originFacility.description: Identifier or name of the facility where the shipment originates.

destinationFacility.description: Identifier or name of the destination facility. May be an encrypted field.

trackingStatus.description: Current tracking status of the shipment.

currentLocation.description: Human-readable description of the shipment's current location.

estimatedDelivery.description: Estimated delivery date in ISO 8601 date format.

lastScannedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent scan event in ISO 8601 format.

handoffPartner.description: Actor ID of the handoff carrier when the shipment is transferred to a partner.

deliveryAddress.description: Delivery address for the shipment. May be an encrypted field.

recipientName.description: Name of the recipient. May be an encrypted field.

recipientPhone.description: Phone number of the recipient. May be an encrypted field.

cbi.description: Canonical Barcode Identifier of the item.

quantity.description: Number of units of this item in the shipment.

contents.description: List of items contained in the shipment.

signatureRequired.description: Whether a signature is required upon delivery.

insuranceValue.description: Declared insurance value with currency. Example: 'USD 150.00'.

handlingInstructions.description: Special handling instructions for the shipment. Examples: ['fragile', 'this-side-up', 'keep-dry'].

temperatureRange.description: Required temperature range for temperature-sensitive shipments.
